  --version                  Show the development version.
  -v, -vv ... -vvvvv         Increase verbosity (maximum 5).
  --verbose LEVEL           Set verbosity to 1..5 or + through +++++.
  --verbose=LEVEL            Equivalent explicit form; -verbose: LEVEL is accepted.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible.

VERBOSITY (stderr only; default 0)
  1 summary; 2 command stages; 3 capability details; 4 elapsed timing;
  5 bounded diagnostic trace. Levels are cumulative. Quiet conflicts with verbosity.
  Payload bytes, metadata, raw addresses and input/output paths are never logged.

USAGE: swiftjli-cli inspect [OPTIONS]

UNAVAILABLE: inspect is reserved for a future codec milestone (exit 4).
No input is opened, no standard input is consumed and no output file is created.
Help describes reserved syntax, not working compression or validation.

RESERVED CODEC OPTIONS
  -i, --input PATH           Input file; '-' will mean standard input.
  -o, --output PATH          Final output; '-' will mean standard output.
  --input-format FORMAT     Explicit source format.
  --output-format FORMAT    Explicit target format.
  --mode MODE               lossless (default), near-lossless or lossy when supported.
  --max-error N             Supported near-lossless error in integer sample units.
  --backend NAME            Explicit supported backend.
  --copy-policy POLICY      require-sharing (default) or allow-copy.
  --threads N               Worker limit; --max-memory BYTES; --timeout SECONDS.
  --overwrite               Permit replacing final output only when implemented.
  --json                    Structured report; no binary stdout contamination.
Command-specific applicability and value validation require codec implementation.

OPTIONS
  -h, --help                 Show this help; also: help [command].
  --version                  Show the development version.
  -v, -vv ... -vvvvv         Increase verbosity (maximum 5).
  --verbose LEVEL           Set verbosity to 1..5 or + through +++++.
  --verbose=LEVEL            Equivalent explicit form; -verbose: LEVEL is accepted.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible.

VERBOSITY (stderr only; default 0)
  1 summary; 2 command stages; 3 capability details; 4 elapsed timing;
  5 bounded diagnostic trace. Levels are cumulative. Quiet conflicts with verbosity.
  Payload bytes, metadata, raw addresses and input/output paths are never logged.

EXIT STATUS
  0 success/help/version; 2 invalid usage; 4 unsupported codec operation;
  6 output I/O failure (including a closed pipe). Future codec errors additionally
  use 3 malformed input, 5 resource/deadline, 7 internal failure, 130 cancellation.

MANUAL
  man swiftjli-cli (installed with the executable by Scripts/install-cli.sh).

SWIFTJLI-CLI(1)          Swift Image Compression Suite         SWIFTJLI-CLI(1)

N NA AM ME E
       swiftjli-cli - help, version and capability reporting for SwiftJLI

S SY YN NO OP PS SI IS S
       s sw wi if ft tj jl li i- -c cl li i [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s] _ c_ o_ m_ m_ a_ n_ d [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s]

D DE ES SC CR RI IP PT TI IO ON N
       This development tool provides help, version and truthful library
       capability reporting.  Codec algorithms are not implemented. Reserved
       encode, decode, inspect and validate commands return 4 without opening
       input, consuming standard input or creating output.  Build with Swift
       6.2 or later in Swift 6 language mode; Swift 6.4 is the qualified
       primary toolchain. Apple OS minimum is 26.0.  CLI hosts are macOS and
       Linux; consult qualification records for executed coverage.

C CO OM MM MA AN ND DS S
       c ca ap pa ab bi il li it ti ie es s [ [- -- -j js so on n] ]
              Report actual library encode/decode/inspect support. JSON is one
              document on stdout.  False support values and empty formats mean
              unavailable algorithms.

       h he el lp p [ [c co om mm ma an nd d] ]
              Show global or command-specific help. No arguments also show
              global help.

       v ve er rs si io on n
              Show the development version.

O OP PT TI IO ON NS S
       - -h h, , - -- -h he el lp p
              Show help, including after a command.

       - -- -v ve er rs si io on n
              Show the development version.

       - -v v, , - -v vv v, , - -v vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv vv v
              Increase diagnostic verbosity, up to 5.

       - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e L LE EV VE EL L, , - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e= =L LE EV VE EL L
              Set level to 1 through 5, or + through +++++. Bare verbose
              increments once.

       - -v ve er rb bo os se e: : L LE EV VE EL L, , - -v ve er rb bo os se e: :L LE EV VE EL L
              Equivalent explicit verbosity spelling; bare -verbose increments
              once.

       - -q q, , - -- -q qu ui ie et t
              Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible. Conflicts
              with verbosity.

D DI IA AG GN NO OS ST TI IC C L LE EV VE EL LS S
       Default 0 reports errors only. Levels are cumulative: 1 summary; 2
       stages; 3 capability/configuration details; 4 elapsed timing; 5 bounded
       trace. Invalid levels or totals above 5 return 2.  Explicit levels set
       and repeated flags increment in argument order.  Diagnostics use
       stderr. Requested help/version/capability data uses stdout.  No payload
       bytes, metadata, raw addresses or input/output paths are logged.

R RE ES SE ER RV VE ED D C CO OD DE EC C S SY YN NT TA AX X
       Codec command help lists reserved -i/--input, -o/--output, --input-
       format, --output-format, --mode, --max-error, --backend, --copy-policy,
       --threads, --max-memory, --timeout, --overwrite and --json.  These are
       not implemented payload operations. A single hyphen will denote
       standard input/output in a future codec command. Default future mode is
       lossless and copy policy is require-sharing. No private intermediate
       image format is implemented.

E EX XI IT T S ST TA AT TU US S
       0 success/help/version; 2 invalid usage; 4 unsupported operation; 6
       output I/O failure including a closed pipe.  Future codec statuses
       reserve 3 malformed input, 5 resource/deadline, 7 internal failure and
       130 user cancellation.

E EX XA AM MP PL LE ES S
       swiftjli-cli -h
       swiftjli-cli help capabilities
       swiftjli-cli capabilities --json -vv
       swiftjli-cli capabilities -verbose: 3
       swiftjli-cli capabilities --verbose=+++++

I IN NS ST TA AL LL LA AT TI IO ON N
       Scripts/install-cli.sh installs or updates the executable and this page
       together.  Use --prefix for an absolute prefix (default /usr/local),
       --destdir or DESTDIR for staging, and --binary for a prebuilt binary
       matching VERSION.  Files are PREFIX/bin/swiftjli-cli and
       PREFIX/share/man/man1/swiftjli-cli.1.  For custom prefixes use man -M
       PREFIX/share/man swiftjli-cli, or configure MANPATH.  No index refresh
       is needed for direct lookup; no sudo runs automatically.

S SE EE E A AL LS SO O
       m ma an n(1)

       CLI.md and Documentation/Engineering/OS27CLI/README.md in the SwiftJLI
       repository.

1.1.0-dev.2                   September 23, 2026               SWIFTJLI-CLI(1)
